diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker satisfied Check C7 and Check C8 by setting 'serialized_labels_required' and 'scan_verification_required' to true. These boolean decisions defaulted to true in the model, allowing the checks to pass without needing the hidden information provided by PF4.

C7.why: The customer addendum changes release controls to serialized two-dimensional labels on every piece and documented scan verification before release.

C8.why: The customer addendum changes release controls to serialized two-dimensional labels on every piece and documented scan verification before release.

fix_instructions: For Check C7 and Check C8, tighten the logic such that 'serialized_labels_required' and 'scan_verification_required' default to false unless explicitly set to true by the relevant agent with access to PF4.
